title: Widget Critical Fixes
description: Four targeted regression fixes in lib/ui/core/widgets/ and lib/ui/core/theme/ following the partially-completed widget-native-migration. Each fix is independent and addresses a concrete bug or violation of the design-system rules captured in the session context (preserve public API, respect MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf, use tokens from lib/ui/core/tokens/, no hardcoded colors). All four subtasks can run in parallel because they edit disjoint files with no shared mutable state.
parallel_strategy: All four subtasks run in a single parallel batch. They touch disjoint files (app_button.dart, app_loading_indicator.dart, app_chip.dart, app_theme.dart) and have no shared dependencies. A single executor can pick up any one of them; multiple executors can run all four simultaneously.
exit_criteria: lib/ui/core/widgets/buttons/app_button.dart uses FilledButton (primary), OutlinedButton (secondary), FilledButton.tonalIcon or equivalent (tertiary), and TextButton (ghost) inside _buildButtonChild — no Container + GestureDetector click stack remains
AppButton public API is byte-identical to the pre-fix version (same constructor signature, same AppButtonVariant, same AppButtonSize, same isLoading/isDisabled/isFullWidth/icon/trailingIcon defaults)

lib/ui/core/widgets/feedback/app_loading_indicator.dart: _PulseIndicator is a StatefulWidget that drives a 0.6 -> 1.0 -> 0.6 scale loop via AnimationController.repeat(reverse: true) — pulse no longer freezes after one cycle
AppLoadingIndicator.pulse renders a static dot when MediaQuery.disableAnimationsOf(context) is true

lib/ui/core/widgets/display/app_chip.dart: the _PressableChip wrapper class is deleted; RawChip is returned directly with its built-in onPressed (no outer GestureDetector around a chip that already handles taps)
lib/ui/core/theme/app_theme.dart: progressIndicatorTheme.color is lightColorScheme.primary inside the light() builder and darkColorScheme.primary inside the dark() builder
All four files compile without errors (flutter analyze returns exit code 0)
No new packages added to pubspec.yaml
No hardcoded Color values introduced in the fix; every color reference points to a ColorScheme or a token in lib/ui/core/tokens/app_colors.dart

constraints.tokens_from_lib/ui/core/tokens/: no hardcoded color or numeric values where a token exists
constraints.scope_discipline: Each subtask edits exactly the file(s) named in its reference_files. Do not refactor adjacent code, do not rename tokens, do not introduce new abstractions.

subtasks.title: AppButton — replace Container+GestureDetector with FilledButton/OutlinedButton/FilledButton.tonalIcon/TextButton
subtasks.summary: Refactor _buildButtonChild in lib/ui/core/widgets/buttons/app_button.dart to return a Material button (FilledButton / OutlinedButton / FilledButton.tonalIcon / TextButton) selected by AppButtonVariant, instead of the current Container + BoxDecoration + GestureDetector stack.

subtasks.title: AppLoadingIndicator.pulse — revert to AnimationController.repeat(reverse: true)
subtasks.summary: Rewrite _PulseIndicator in lib/ui/core/widgets/feedback/app_loading_indicator.dart as a StatefulWidget that owns an AnimationController with vsync and calls repeat(reverse: true), driving a 0.6 -> 1.0 -> 0.6 scale loop continuously. Drop _SinePulseTween (TweenAnimationBuilder only animates once and freezes after 2s).

subtasks.title: AppChip — remove _PressableChip wrapper to fix double-gesture conflict
subtasks.summary: Delete the _PressableChip wrapper class and its surrounding if-block in lib/ui/core/widgets/display/app_chip.dart so RawChip is returned directly. RawChip already owns onPressed handling and its own splash feedback; the outer GestureDetector was double-firing taps.

subtasks.title: app_theme.dart — make progressIndicatorTheme.color theme-aware
subtasks.summary: Replace the hardcoded color: AppColors.primary in both light() and dark() progressIndicatorTheme blocks (lines 89 and 191) with lightColorScheme.primary and darkColorScheme.primary respectively. linearTrackColor / circularTrackColor already use the ColorScheme and need no change.
